rationale: D-P-7 (openspec/changes/l7-phase-framing, 2026-09-27): phase completion is capability-only. v6 = v5 with every completion instruction naming the declare_done capability (ANALYZE, the non-correspondence exit, REMEDIATE); contract, workflow, ceiling and grant bytes identical to v5. Evidence: the host D-P-5 gate capture in which gpt-oss:20b wrote "ANALYZE phase complete." as prose and never called declare_done. v5 stays active as history; rsys@7 admits v6 only.
